svg.title: dots.tts full NFE sweep: RTX 4090 x-vector run
svg.desc: Three plots show latency, real-time factor, and generated audio duration across the full x-vector prompt sweep.
svg.text: dots.tts full NFE sweep • RTX 4090 x-vector run
54 prompts • 9 NFE settings • 486 measured generations • one per prompt/NFE • warmups excluded
Across the nine NFEs, median latency is lower than the original run by 27% to 35%.
Prompt set, seed, solver, precision, and guidance match. GPU labels are reported; only x-vector conditioning is recorded.
Wall-clock time per generated WAV across the prompt set.
RTF = latency / WAV duration. Values below 1 are faster than playback.
Generated clip length across prompts. Duration alone does not verify spoken content.
GPU model is reported by the run owner; archived result rows identify the device only as CUDA.
